definitions: To do things that you don't normally do and that make you feel a little uncomfortable but that can help you to grow as a person.
To intentionally put oneself in new or unfamiliar situations in order to challenge oneself and gain new experiences.
examples: I decided to step out of my comfort zone and try public speaking.
Learning a new language forced me to step out of my comfort zone.
Traveling solo was a great way for her to step out of her comfort zone.
lemma: step out of one's comfort zone
source: step out of my comfort zone
